glance.h2: What a 1-Bed vs. a 2-Bed Sells For
glance.lede: Every home at Del Mar Villas is a single-level 1- or 2-bedroom. Here's what each sold for over the last 5 years.
glance.ratio: About two of every three sales are 2-bedrooms. The 1-bedroom plan is one of the lowest-priced ways into a 92130 address.

life.lead: Del Mar Villas was built in 1990 as an apartment community and became condominiums in 2004. That history explains two things buyers notice right away: grounds with more than 30 years of mature trees and lawn, and an amenity list larger than most Carmel Valley condo complexes at this price. Every home is a single-level flat with its own patio or balcony.
reasons: Carmel Del Mar Elementary and Carmel Valley Middle School are each about 0.3 miles away, and Torrey Pines High is about a mile.
The recreation center and library, Piazza Carmel, One Paseo and Del Mar Highlands Town Center are all within a 12-minute walk.
Dues of about $330–$370 a month are among the lowest of any Carmel Valley condo community, and they cover water and trash.

hoa.h2: Del Mar Villas Monthly Dues & Amenities
hoa.intro: One monthly payment covers the grounds, the buildings' exteriors and a long list of shared amenities.
hoa.fee_note: 2025 sales listed $330–$365; the 2026 listings show $370, so expect about $370 now. Confirm the current amount for a specific home.
hoa.also: water, trash, landscaping, exterior building and roof maintenance, and common-area upkeep.
hoa.compare_note: Del Mar Villas has the lowest monthly dues of these nearby condo communities. It does carry a small Mello-Roos tax, which The Lakes does not. Ranges are from 2025–2026 MLS listings.

faq_h2: Del Mar Villas Carmel Valley FAQs

faq.q: How much do Del Mar Villas Carmel Valley homes sell for?
faq.a: Over the last 5 years, Del Mar Villas condos sold between about $536,000 and $769,000: 1-bedrooms $536K–$599K (median $593K) and 2-bedrooms $650K–$769K (median about $684K).

faq.q: What are the monthly dues at Del Mar Villas?
faq.a: MLS listings show $330–$370 a month: 2025 sales listed $330–$365, and the 2026 listings show $370. The dues cover water, trash, landscaping, exterior and roof maintenance, and the pool, spa, sauna, fitness center, courts and clubhouse. Confirm the current amount for a specific home.

faq.q: Does Del Mar Villas have Mello-Roos?
faq.a: Yes, a small one: about $366–$452 a year, or roughly $30–$38 a month. Few listings report it, so check the tax bill for the specific home. The base property tax rate is about 1.07% of the purchase price.

faq.q: Are Del Mar Villas homes condos or townhomes?
faq.a: They're condominiums, not townhomes. Every home is a single-level flat on one floor, either a ground-floor or an upper-floor unit, with a private patio or balcony.

faq.q: How big are the homes at Del Mar Villas?
faq.a: There are three floor plans: a 638 sq ft 1-bedroom, 1-bath, and two 2-bedroom, 2-bath plans of about 864 and 950 sq ft.

faq.q: What is parking like at Del Mar Villas?
faq.a: Homes come with covered parking and a storage space. There are no private garages.

faq.q: How quickly do Del Mar Villas condos sell?
faq.a: The median time on market over the last 5 years was about 20 days, so well-priced homes usually go under contract within three weeks.

faq.q: I own at Del Mar Villas. What affects my sale price most?
faq.a: Condition. Because the buildings date from 1990, buyers compare finishes closely, and a fully updated home can sell for $100K or more above one in original condition. Floor plan and location within the grounds matter next. I can show you which recent sales are true comparisons for your home.
